title: PRD-09 Battery refurbishment
summary: Active cost centre for battery refurbishment in unit NBC-MAN-01 under owner PJANSEN, processing warranty returns and quarantined battery packs.
body:
Cost centre PRD-09 covers battery refurbishment operations at Northbridge Cycles within operational unit NBC-MAN-01 under owner [[user-pjansen|Pieter Jansen]][^r1]. It serves as a mandatory processing destination for returned warranty battery packs and quarantined stock requiring rework[^r7][^r8]. As of 26 October 2026 09:00, the cost centre is OPEN with an available budget of £486,932.90 for period 2026-Q4[^r1][^r2].

## Operations and workflow

All warranty battery packs returned from bike shops must be quarantined immediately upon arrival and routed directly to battery refurbishment under PRD-09 or scrapped for recycling, and must never be returned to general inventory stock[^r7]. Under quality procedures, cost centre PRD-09 represents one of three official disposition routes determined by [[cc-qa-01|Quality]] within 24 hours of quarantine, alongside recycling or return to supplier[^r8]. The cost centre processes refurbished packs, handling stock associated with [[items-bat|BAT-* items]][^r7][^r8].

## Budget and expenditure

Budget allocations and commitments are recorded in [[data-cost-centres-and-budgets|Cost Centres and Budgets FY2026-27]][^r1][^r2]. For the current active period, 2026-Q4, PRD-09 has an authorised budget of £758,000, committed expenditure of £271,067.10, and an available balance of £486,932.90[^r2][^r3].

Historical quarterly figures for financial year 2025 across all periods were:
* 2025-Q1: budget £777,000; committed spend £590,996.55[^r4].
* 2025-Q2: budget £941,000; committed spend £679,681.44[^r4].
* 2025-Q3: budget £895,000; committed spend £653,890.54[^r4].
* 2025-Q4: budget £887,000; committed spend £806,450.70[^r4].

Historical quarterly figures for earlier periods in 2026 were:
* 2026-Q1: budget £1,045,000; committed spend £830,980.18[^r5].
* 2026-Q2: budget £1,003,000; committed spend £602,798.46[^r5].
* 2026-Q3: budget £924,000; committed spend £888,546.24[^r5].

## Versions and conflicts

* **2027-Q1 budget allocation**: Today's active period is 2026-Q4 with a budget of £758,000 and £271,067.10 committed[^r2][^r3]. From 1 January 2027, cost centre PRD-09 has an allocated budget of £865,000 with 0 committed for period 2027-Q1 (`future_dated`)[^r6].
